status: Blockout (pass 1): silhouette, sections, mass, slots and engines. No detail, damage or textures.
units: One sprite pixel per unit about the .ship centre; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres

scale.summary: Single-seat support bomber: X-frame, emitter housing to port, missile rack to starboard, twin drive pods
scale.method: Crew 1 (ship_data min/max crew 1). The cockpit dome is about 5.9 units long and 2.5 wide at the sill; a single-seat canopy of 2.6-3.0 m by 1.1 m gives 0.44-0.5 m/unit. At 0.45 the seated 1.8 m proxy clears the glass, each 8-unit drive pod is 3.6 m across around a 1.4 m nozzle (the class of a single fighter turbofan), the starboard rack is a 1.5 m-wide missile cell and the airframe is 15 m long by 14.4 m across the arms, a light strike aircraft. Below 0.4 the canopy shrinks under 2.4 m and the 1.8 m pilot loses head room; above 0.55 the fuselage passes 18 m on a fighter-class bomber launched in numbers from a carrier.

sprite.pixel_to_model: col c, row r (from top) covers X 20-r..21-r, Y 16-c..17-c

root.name: Longbow root
root.note: the .ship centre: the game's rotation pivot

anchor_convention: ARROWS empties; local +X points along the slot angle (0 = nose, 180 = aft)
notes: The sprite is symmetric about Y = 0 except for its launchers, which are unequal on purpose (master v2 restores them): a pointed emitter housing on the port arm, a boxed rack on the starboard arm.
WS 001 (pdburst, HIDDEN) anchors exactly at (14, 12) in the port housing; the housing's pointed emitter runs forward on the sprite's spike axis Y 11.3 with its muzzle at the tip (20.4, 11.3).
WS 002 (sabot_fighter, HIDDEN) anchors exactly at (9, -11) inside the starboard rack; its muzzle is on the rack's open front face (13.1, -11).
Engine slots (-13, 9) and (-13, -8) straddle the even-width sprite's centre line; the drive pods are modelled symmetric on the sprite's pods at Y +-9 (8 units wide = slot width).

The visible bells sit at the master's painted nozzles, slot + renderEngineOffsetsNativePx = (-12.5, 11.5) and (-12.5, -11), outboard in each pod and recessed 0.5 into its aft face (-13); exhaust anchors are at those bells.
The master's long pointed nose and outboard pods are not followed: the sprite ends the fuselage at X 13 between two forward sensor prongs and centres its pods on Y +-9.

silhouette.method: top render alpha vs sprite alpha (>127), nearest-sampled into the top camera frame at 28.36 px per unit
